nodes: Top-level shell that composes all parts (editor area, sidebars, statusbar, titlebar) and manages layout lifecycle.
Monaco-based code editor widget; text models, cursor, bracket matching, folding, inline completions, diff editor.
Isolated Node.js/web worker process running extension code; communicates with main process via RPC protocol.
Integrated terminal using xterm.js; manages PTY processes, profiles, and shell integration.
Full-text and semantic file search; ripgrep backend, search view, replace, semantic search behavior.
Source-control model abstraction; history view, repository/provider management, decoration of changed files.
Debug Adapter Protocol client; breakpoints, call stack, variables view, inline values, REPL.
Interactive notebook editor for .ipynb and custom formats; cell execution, output rendering, kernel management.
Test explorer, test result storage, gutter decorations, coverage reporting, test run profiles.
Settings UI and JSON editor, configuration registry, keybinding editing, sync of user preferences.
Task runner system; problem matchers, task definitions, build/test task execution, status-bar indicators.
Language feature aggregation: completion, hover, references, rename, diagnostics via LSP and extension API.
Auth provider registration, session management, MCP auth flows, usage/access tracking per provider.
Remote connection infrastructure; SSH/Tunnels/WSL indicator, port forwarding, remote extension scanning.
Auto-update lifecycle; release notes display, quality channel switching, post-update widget.
Extension gallery browsing, install/uninstall/enable lifecycle, built-in scanner, feature gating.
Cross-cutting singletons: file system, keybinding, commands, menus, context keys, instantiation DI container.
Cross-device sync of settings, keybindings, snippets, extensions, and profiles via a sync service.
Bottom status-bar composing entries from all subsystems (language, SCM, tasks, remote, debug, errors).
In-editor and panel chat UI; AI completions entitlement gating, agent host resource management, MCP integration.

changeEvents: Remote Development extension pack (SSH/Containers/WSL) introduced, establishing Remote subsystem architecture as a first-class workbench layer.
Native Notebook editor support (Jupyter .ipynb) landed in core workbench, introducing the Notebook subsystem as an embedded-editor composition model.
Built-in Testing subsystem added with Test Explorer UI, replacing extension-only test runners with a first-party editor-decorated model.
Settings Sync reached stable, connecting the Settings subsystem to cloud-backed UserDataSync with profile-aware credential flow via Authentication.
Terminal rewritten with GPU-accelerated canvas renderer (xterm.js 5); pty host moved to a dedicated separate process, decoupling Terminal from Workbench process stability.
Authentication service refactored from single Microsoft provider to a multi-provider registry; Extension Management now gates marketplace access via auth sessions.
Auth multi-provider architecture visible in workbench.common.main.ts service imports; exact milestone inferred from public changelog pattern
GitHub Copilot Chat (inline chat + panel) integrated directly into workbench core as 'chat' subsystem, augmenting the Editor with AI completions via inlineCompletionsUnification.

HISTORY_VIEW_PANE_ID directly visible in scm.contribution.ts imports from common/scm.js
Model Context Protocol (MCP) authentication services added (authenticationMcpService, authenticationMcpUsageService) bridging Authentication and Chat subsystems for agentic tool use.
Directly visible as six new MCP-related auth service imports in workbench.common.main.ts lines 88-95

Agent Sessions (sessions/common/theme.js, sessions/common/sizes.js) and agentHost connection services added; VS Code 1.132.0 ships agentic multi-tool orchestration across Chat, Editor, and Extension Host.
